Last updated: 23 October 2026
How the Costanera Corrientes Guide handles the minimum information needed to run this independent informational website.

Our commitment

The Costanera Corrientes Guide is an independent visitor information project. We aim to collect the smallest amount of data possible and use it only to operate, understand and improve this website.

Information we may process

When you browse, technical services may process limited information such as IP address, browser type, pages visited, approximate date and time, cookie identifiers and diagnostic data.

How we use information

Technical information is used to deliver the site safely, prevent misuse, understand aggregated browsing patterns where analytics consent is given and improve the clarity of content. We do not sell personal data or publish individual profiles.

Legal basis and retention

Where applicable, we process technical data for our legitimate interest in running a safe website and meeting legal obligations. Analytics cookies are activated only with your choice. We keep information only for the period reasonably necessary for those purposes or required by applicable law.

Third-party services

The site embeds Google Maps to show the location. Google Analytics 4 loads only if you accept analytics cookies. These providers may process information under their own policies; review them before using their services.

Resources and hosting

Forecasts are requested by the Worker from Open-Meteo; the browser requests the embedded map from Google Maps. Cloudflare hosts this site and may inject a performance/RUM beacon, separate from the Analytics choice and not controlled by this setting.

Your rights

Depending on your jurisdiction, you may request access, correction, deletion, objection or restriction of processing, and lodge a complaint with the relevant data-protection authority. You may also withdraw analytics-cookie consent at any time in Cookie settings.

Changes to this policy

We may update this policy to reflect operational, legal or provider changes. The month shown at the top identifies the current version of this text.
